explanation: Rechecking confirms that all partial derivatives exist for xy>0 and z≠0, and also at (0,0,z) with z≠0: f(h,0,z)=f(0,h,z)=1/z, so f_x=f_y=0, while f_z=−1/z². At other points with xy=0, one coordinate derivative fails. Hence none of the choices gives the complete set. Option a describes only where the supplied formulas are defined, which caused the earlier uncertainty.
